Prompt Engineering:
 
About the Role
We are seeking a talented and motivated Prompt Engineering to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate has a strong background in Python, experience building scalable backend systems, and a good understanding of modern development practices. Exposure to AI/LLMs (Large Language Models) is highly desirable, as you will help integrate AI-driven features into our applications. 
Responsibilities
Integrate third-party APIs, services, and databases into applications.
Work with AI/LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face) to build intelligent features.
Apply prompt engineering techniques to improve AI model outputs and user experiences.
Write clean, reusable, and efficient code following best practices.
Requirements:
Experience: 2–3 years of professional software development experience with Python.
Strong knowledge of Python frameworks (e.g., Django, Flask, FastAPI).
Good understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL, e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB).
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Experience working with LLMs, vector databases, or AI model fine-tuning (preferred).
Knowledge of prompt engineering, embeddings, and integrating AI-driven workflows into production systems (preferred).
What We Offer
Competitive salary and benefits package.
Opportunity to work on impactful projects with modern technologies, including AI/LLMs.
Collaborative and growth-oriented work environment.
Flexible work options (remote/hybrid based on role).
